title: Process peak memory
responsibility: Runs a command under the system time utility with a deadline and returns peak resident bytes when the platform report is available, otherwise an unavailable reason.

inputs.name: peakMemory.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed directly to the executable.

inputs.name: peakMemory.input
inputs.description: Text written to the child standard input.

inputs.name: peakMemory.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Maximum child execution time in milliseconds; defaults to 60000.

outputs.name: peakMemory
outputs.description: Peak resident bytes from a successful BSD/GNU time report, converting GNU kB to bytes; otherwise returns an unavailable reason. The command is run asynchronously with a timeout and output limit.

errors.name: Bounded command failure
errors.description: the time-wrapped child can reject on launch failure, timeout, cancellation or output overflow
